_about: Director layout for V07 page 9. Units: pt, origin top-left, page 864x648, content area x 24-840, y 24-618. Text comes from the contract by block id; this file only places it.
hierarchy: Two story beats per row. Top: Navya's decision (wide) and Vihaan's wry reaction (tall close-up). Bottom: Tez's two explanations side by side, each with room for its long narration.

panels.compose: Eye-level medium shot. Three children in one line across the centre (Ahana left, Vihaan centre, Navya right), heads between 30% and 45% of the frame height. Waiting crowd small and soft behind them. Upper-left 50% x 22% calm (dark gate stone / night sky) for a one-line caption.

Medium close-up, portrait-shaped frame. Vihaan only, head and shoulders to waist, in the right two-thirds, face at about 60% across and 45% down. Upper-left 75% x 30% calm (gate stone and dark leaves) for a three-line speech balloon.

Medium-wide from beside the emergency hatch. Tez sitting at frame-left; Ahana, Vihaan, Navya standing left-to-right towards frame-right. All heads below 36% of the frame height. Top 34% calm (gate leaves in shadow) for a five-line caption.

Low medium shot. Tez at frame-left, right forepaw open towards the closed gate; Ahana centre-left, Vihaan centre-right, Navya right, all looking at Tez. Heads below 32% of the frame height. Top 30% calm for a four-line caption.
